resources.string: Say SENA in English. An open palm pauses the video, and a thumbs-up plays it.
Wake word model file is missing: %1$s
This wake word is English. Say %1$s to open the camera. Speech is checked on this phone and is not uploaded.
Show the wake word over other apps
When SENA is heard, a blue banner appears briefly over YouTube. Allow this app to display over other apps. Without that, only a notification is shown. The banner does not take touches.
Without notification permission, the status notification and its stop button can stay hidden. You can come back to this app and tap Stop control.

Notification access is different from permission to post notifications. Android shows other apps\' media sessions only to apps with this access. This app uses that list to find YouTube playback and request pause or play. Notification contents are not saved or uploaded. Turn this app on in Settings, then come back. The status is checked again.
Control can start only while this screen is visible.
The gesture model file is missing.
The required permissions are already allowed.
The system will not show the permission dialog again. Allow the permission in app settings.
Could not open the settings screen.
Posting notifications is for this app\'s status. It is separate from notification access.
Notifications: this Android version does not ask for a separate runtime permission.
YouTube app: installation could not be confirmed
Denied with do not ask again: %1$s. Allow it in app settings.
The gesture model file is missing. Check assets/%1$s.
Notification access is off, so the YouTube session cannot be seen.
Say SENA in English. The camera stays closed while waiting.
The microphone is open. Say SENA in English, then pause briefly.
Sound is coming in. Say SENA in English, then pause briefly.
The microphone is open but almost silent. Say SENA closer to the phone.
The microphone could not be read. Check whether another app is using it.
Heard SENA. Opening the front camera.
No open palm or thumbs-up was confirmed within 10 seconds. No command was sent.
Open palm confirmed. Closing the camera and requesting pause in YouTube.
Thumbs-up confirmed. Closing the camera and requesting play in YouTube.
Could not open the camera. It will not reopen immediately after this failure. Cause: %1$s
The camera did not start within %1$d ms.
The gesture recognizer is unavailable. Cause: %1$s
There is no active media session. Play a regular video in YouTube, then try again.
No YouTube (%1$s) session. Other apps are not controlled: %2$s
Pause was requested. It was already paused before the request.
Pause was requested, and YouTube confirmed the paused state.
Play was requested. It was already playing before the request.
Play was requested, and YouTube confirmed the playing state.
Pause was requested, but the paused state was not confirmed in time.
Play was requested, but the playing state was not confirmed in time.
Notification access is off, so media sessions cannot be read.
The YouTube session says it does not support %1$s. A play/pause toggle was not used instead.
The YouTube command did not finish. %1$s
The media session did not respond in time.
Could not start the foreground service. %1$s
A YouTube session exists, but its playback state could not be read. The session can be empty while paused.
Shows wake-word waiting and gesture recognition status.
Briefly announces that the wake word was heard.
